sinopsis.es: El día en que cumple 35 años, Marcus y su madre buscan un lugar en la costa para esparcir las cenizas del padre. Cuando su madre se enferma, él empieza a sentir que la sal del mar donde el padre descansa le corroe lentamente la vida.
sinopsis.en: On his 35th birthday, Marcus and his mother search for a place on the coast to scatter his father’s ashes. When his mother falls ill, he begins to feel that the salt of the sea where his father rests slowly corrodes his life.
